sender.zh: 交友軟體上的帥哥美女、自稱「鄰居」傳LINE搭訕的陌生人
sender.en: An attractive match on a dating app, or a stranger who messages on LINE claiming to be a neighbour

name.zh: 假交友：網友或「鄰居」培養感情後，帶你投資APP或開網路商店
name.en: Fake romance or new friend who gets you into an investment app or online shop

how.zh: 詐騙者在交友軟體或社群平台主動認識你，或假裝是傳錯訊息的鄰居，每天噓寒問暖、傳早安圖，建立感情和信任。過一陣子開始聊「投資回饋」、「公司內部優惠」或「一起創業開網路商城」，要你下載來路不明的APP或註冊假商城。先讓你小額獲利成功提領，再鼓吹「存越多賺越多」，要你用泰達幣（USDT）等虛擬貨幣儲值或補貨款。大筆投入後就無法出金，對方也失聯。另有集團以AI變聲、找人陪約會，再用手術費、課程費等名目要錢或要你買禮物。
how.en: The scammer befriends you on a dating app or social media, or pretends to be a neighbour who messaged you by mistake, and builds trust with daily chats and good-morning pictures. After a while they talk about “investment rebates”, a “company insider deal” or “starting an online shop together”, and get you to install an unknown app or register on a fake marketplace. You first make a small profit and can withdraw it; then they push you to “deposit more to earn more”, topping up in USDT or other crypto or paying for stock. After a big deposit you can't withdraw and they disappear. Some gangs use AI voice changers or send someone on dates, then ask for money for surgery, courses or gifts.

text.zh: 在交友軟體認識，或陌生人以「鄰居」名義傳LINE，每天聊天拉近關係。
text.en: You meet on a dating app, or a “neighbour” messages you on LINE and chats every day.

text.zh: 對方介紹穩賺不賠的投資、購物回饋或一起開網路商店。
text.en: They introduce a sure-win investment, a shopping rebate or an online shop to run together.

text.zh: 要你下載不明APP，用虛擬貨幣儲值，先讓你小額出金成功。
text.en: They have you install an unknown app and top up in crypto, letting a small withdrawal succeed first.

text.zh: 大額投入後無法出金，被要求再繳費用，對方失聯。
text.en: After a large deposit you cannot withdraw, are asked for more fees, and they vanish.

text.zh: 寶貝，我舅舅在交易所做內部操盤，這個平台每天穩定賺百分之十，我已經賺了不少。你先儲值一點試試看，出金很快的。APP下載：[連結]
text.en: Darling, my uncle trades inside an exchange. This platform makes a steady ten percent a day and I've already made a lot. Top up a little to try it; withdrawals are fast. Download the app: [link]

text.zh: 不好意思打擾了，我是樓上的住戶，管委會說您家天花板在滴水，所以給了我您的LINE。原來是誤會，真的很抱歉！以後當個朋友吧，每天跟您說早安。
text.en: Sorry to bother you, I live upstairs. The building committee said your ceiling was leaking, so they gave me your LINE. It turns out it was a mix-up, I'm so sorry! Let's be friends; I'll say good morning every day.

zh: 在交友軟體認識的網友叫我下載投資APP
網友說用泰達幣儲值可以拿回饋
自稱鄰居的人加我LINE後推薦我投資
男朋友叫我一起在網路商城開店要先補貨款
投資平台說要繳保證金才能出金
網友說公司內部優惠要我下載APP買產品
en: someone i met on a dating app told me to install an investment app
my online friend said i get rebates if i top up with usdt
a so-called neighbour added me on line and recommended an investment
my boyfriend wanted us to open a store on an online mall and pay for stock
the platform says i must pay a deposit before i can withdraw
my online friend told me to download an app to buy products with an insider discount

zh: 剛認識、沒見過面的網友就聊投資或賺錢
要你下載非官方的APP或用虛擬貨幣儲值
先讓你小額獲利，再鼓吹加碼
出金前要先繳保證金、稅金或升級費
en: Someone you've just met and never seen talks about investing or making money.
You are told to install an unofficial app or top up with crypto.
A small profit first, then pressure to put in more.
A deposit, tax or upgrade fee before you can withdraw.

zh: 網友提到投資、虛擬貨幣或開店就停下來，先打165問
不要下載對方給的APP或連結
不要匯款、不要買虛擬貨幣給對方
已經受騙請帶著對話紀錄和匯款證明到警察局報案
en: Stop as soon as an online friend brings up investing, crypto or opening a shop, and call 165 first.
Don't install an app or open a link they send.
Don't transfer money or buy crypto for them.
If you were cheated, take the chats and transfer records to a police station.
